_comment: MACHINE-READABLE LAB CLASSIFICATION — the single source of truth for which lab books
run in the default reproduction pipeline and which may feed the website.
Hand-maintained; guarded by tests/test_lab_manifest.py (every scripts/lab_*.py must appear
here exactly once, and the reproduce/publication consumers must agree with it).
Consumers: scripts/reproduce.sh (default lab set) and scripts/build_data.py (publication),
both via the typed loader src/agentic_dynamics/reporting/lab_manifest.py.
Why this file exists: docs/reviews/semantic_integrity_review.md P0 — the lab pipeline
bypassed the canonical data-integrity boundary. _results_summary.json is RETIRED (144
entries, replaced by the registry-backed canonical corpus in build_data.py), yet labs still
read it and the website still published their output. This manifest is release item 1
(quarantine): classify every lab, then remove the noncanonical ones from default
reproduction and from publication.
PHASE s2 (contract): every publication-eligible lab consumes ONLY the canonical registry
resolver (src/agentic_dynamics/reporting/canonical_corpus.py) and embeds a lab_contract block
(src/agentic_dynamics/reporting/lab_contract.py) carrying input_dataset_id,
input_manifest_sha256, registry_version, metric_definition_version, data_integrity_policy and
requires_external_service. build_data.py re-validates the manifest hash and refuses to publish
a stale artifact, logging the rejection with the lab name.
PHASE s4 (Grit collision): 'Grit' now has exactly ONE meaning repo-wide —
G(s) = P(test_executed_success | perturbation_strength = s), implemented by lab_grit.py.
The quadrant analysis that used to carry the name was renamed
lab_grit_matrix.py -> lab_correctness_escape_quadrants.py (quadrant 'high_grit' -> 'robust',
metric_definition_version v1 -> v2) and stays quarantined.

status_vocabulary.canonical: Consumes only live, non-retired result records. Runs in the default reproduction pipeline and is eligible to feed the website (subject to the s2 lineage contract).
status_vocabulary.historical: Kept for provenance and still runnable by hand (`agentic-dynamics analyze lab <name>`), but its question or corpus belongs to a superseded measurement era. Not published.
status_vocabulary.quarantined: Consumes a RETIRED or otherwise noncanonical source (directly or transitively). The file is kept (historical record) but it is NOT run by reproduce.sh and its output is NOT published. Lifting a quarantine requires re-pointing the lab at a canonical source.

field_semantics.publication_eligible: Hard gate: may this lab's output reach apps/website/data.js at all? quarantined => always false.
field_semantics.website_key: The data.js key this lab feeds, or null when the site consumes nothing from it. build_data.py loads a lab only when publication_eligible AND website_key is set.
field_semantics.reproduce_default: Is this lab in scripts/reproduce.sh's default (core) lab set? quarantined => always false.
field_semantics.output: Artifact the lab writes under experiments/results/, or null when it only prints to stdout. Quarantined labs write into experiments/results/legacy_labs/ so the canonical results directory holds only contract-bearing outputs (see that directory's README).
field_semantics.input_sources: Every dataset the lab reads, as repo-relative paths/globs (transitive sources noted in rationale).
field_semantics.reads_retired_summary: True when experiments/results/_results_summary.json is reached directly or transitively.
field_semantics.requires_external_service: External dependency that makes the lab non-deterministic/unavailable offline (neo4j | sonarqube | opencode_inference), else null.
field_semantics.contract_status: s2 lineage contract state: 'enforced' = the lab consumes the canonical registry resolver and embeds a lab_contract block in its output; 'n/a' = quarantined, contract not applicable.
field_semantics.rationale: Why this classification — the evidence, not the intent.
field_semantics.metric_definition_version: Version of this lab's metric definitions, embedded in its output contract. Bump when a metric changes meaning (e.g. the s4 Grit resolution). Required for publication_eligible labs.

lab_basin_topology.py.rationale: Reads the retired summary directly (scripts/lab_basin_topology.py:18) and classifies basins over the retired SEMANTIC/MANIFOLD taxonomy.

lab_basin_topology_neo4j.py.rationale: Transitively summary-derived: the ExperimentRun nodes it queries are loaded from the retired summary (src/agentic_dynamics/knowledge/graph.py:245, Neo4jClient.load_runs), and it validates against the quarantined lab_basin_topology.json. Also requires a live Neo4j, which is why reproduce.sh:56-57 (unconditional inclusion) was flagged P1.

lab_cache_economics.py.rationale: Consumes the canonical registry resolver only (reporting.canonical_corpus, story table). Contract-bearing: the output embeds input_dataset_id/input_manifest_sha256/registry_version/metric_definition_version/data_integrity_policy/requires_external_service.

lab_claude_audit.py.rationale: Reads the retired summary directly (scripts/lab_claude_audit.py:16); the $47.54 audit is a claim about the retired corpus.

lab_condition_effects.py.rationale: Consumes the canonical registry resolver only (story + review tables). Conditions come from the resolver's no-op relabel, and the 77 tombstoned early_degrade cells are excluded — both load-bearing for a condition comparison. Contract-bearing. metric_definition_version bumped v1 -> v2 in m2 (measurement-contribution closure): cost went missing-as-zero to captured-only, so the published per-condition average changed meaning.

lab_correctness_escape_quadrants.py.rationale: Reads the retired summary directly, so it stays quarantined. RENAMED in phase s4 from lab_grit_matrix.py: it classified correctness x escape quadrants and called one 'high_grit', colliding with the ONE formal definition of Grit (G(s) = P(test_executed_success | perturbation_strength = s)) that the README, the glossary and the website state. The quadrant is now 'robust'; the formal metric has its own canonical implementation in lab_grit.py. metric_definition_version bumped v1 -> v2 to record the rename — the quantity is unchanged, only its name.

lab_grit.py.rationale: THE formal Grit metric, G(s) = P(test_executed_success | perturbation_strength = s) — the definition the README, the glossary and the website already state. Added in phase s4 (review item 4) because the definition was published with no implementation behind it while a quadrant chart carried the name. Consumes the canonical registry resolver (finding + story tables); 144 canonical cells carry both required fields. Contract-bearing. metric_definition_version bumped v1 -> v2 in the finding-economics closure: the finding corpus Grit conditions on now publishes its economics and optional measurements as null-with-coverage (never numeric zero), so the finding-corpus publication semantics changed even though G(s)'s formula is unchanged.

lab_opencode_meta_analysis.py.rationale: Transitively summary-derived via opencode_analyzer._load_summary (src/agentic_dynamics/reporting/opencode_analyzer.py:23,26). It is also a meta-EXPERIMENT: it spends real inference and is nondeterministic, so it can never belong to a deterministic core reproduction.

input_sources: registry:data_manifest.json#registry (analysis joined on current story rows)
lab_quality_frontier.py.rationale: Consumes the canonical registry resolver only. Analysis artifacts are not a registered source_type, but the resolver reads analysis_<story_id>.json only for CURRENT story rows — a registry-filtered join, not a directory glob. Contract-bearing. metric_definition_version bumped v1 -> v2 in m2 (measurement-contribution closure): the population became 371 resolved / 312 joined (was 371/371), and the optional metrics now carry coverage.

lab_sonar_quality.py.rationale: Reads the retired summary directly (scripts/lab_sonar_quality.py:23) and depends on its sonar_* per-cell fields, which have no canonical replacement (build_data._compute_sonar already emits an explicit [P] historical marker for exactly this reason). Prints to stdout; writes no artifact.

lab_story_arc.py.rationale: Consumes the canonical registry resolver only (story table). Cited on the evidence page (D.labs.story_arc). Contract-bearing.

lab_story_review.py.rationale: Consumes the canonical registry resolver only; the typed load_story_result loader runs on the paths the registry resolved (_source_path), never on a glob. Eligible, but no site section consumes it today (website_key null), so build_data does not load it. Contract-bearing. metric_definition_version bumped v1 -> v2 in m2 (measurement-contribution closure): missing correctness became null (never an averaged-in zero) and cost became captured-only.

lab_task_routing.py.rationale: Reads the retired summary directly (scripts/lab_task_routing.py:15). Note: the website's routing section does NOT come from this lab — build_data derives it from agentic_dynamics.control.routing.compute_routing over the canonical corpus, so quarantining this lab does not remove a published section.

lab_verification_frontier.py.rationale: Consumes the canonical registry resolver only (story table). Contract-bearing. metric_definition_version bumped v1 -> v2 in m2 (measurement-contribution closure): model cost became captured-only (a missing/zero cost is no longer averaged in as $0).

lab_verification_value.py.rationale: Consumes the canonical registry resolver only (story + review tables); reviews join to stories via their registry logical_locator, replacing the old filename heuristic. Contract-bearing. metric_definition_version bumped v1 -> v2 in m1 (measurement-contribution closure): the join now fails explicitly (review_without_current_story) and story_without_review is counted, so the published correlation contains only joined observations.

lab_beta_from_corpus.py.rationale: Observational β coordination-tax estimate from the session corpus (preregistered 2026-08-31); reads the opencode DB + story files + the usage ledger, never the retired summary — standalone analysis artifact, not a publication lab.
